name: ts-pt-dimer
ini:
[Main]
job = saddle_search
finite_difference = 0.001
random_seed = 1
parallel = false

[Potential]
potential = ext_pot
ext_pot_path = /tmp/optbench-extpot-q8tn7lje/extpot-bridge

[Optimizer]
opt_method = lbfgs
convergence_metric = norm
converged_force = 0.001
max_move = 0.2
max_iterations = 1000
lbfgs_memory = 20
lbfgs_inverse_curvature = 0.01
lbfgs_max_inverse_curvature = 0.0
lbfgs_auto_scale = true
lbfgs_angle_reset = true
lbfgs_distance_reset = true

[Dimer]
opt_method = cg
improved = true
finite_angle = 0.005
converged_angle = 5.0
rotations_max = 10
rotations_min = 1

[Saddle Search]
min_mode_method = dimer
client_displace_type = load
converged_force = 0.001
max_iterations = 1000
displace_magnitude = 0.1
